lines.trans: Maybe we will not perform at all?
Samson, we agreed on everything!
I am a living person too, after all.
Then try for the sake of our children.
You know what? Cheat on me too!
What? What are you saying?
So that our score is one-one!
Then this will never end.
Go, I am telling you seriously.
And with whom should I cheat?
With the clerk from the grocery store!
Have you completely lost your mind, Samson?
Stop the foolishness and just pull yourself together!
Alright, I am ready for the performance.

meanings.note: Что за глупости? = What nonsense?. Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common feminine noun meaning 'nonsense, foolishness' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: 'договоримся' = we'll work something out

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('living, alive, live').

meanings.note: The thing that ends is the subject. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'кончиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to end, to be over', paired with 'заканчиваться'.
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.text: Всё, выборы закончились. Тебя начальник ждёт.
examples.trans: That's it, the election is over. Your boss is waiting for you.

meanings.note: A fact or a person. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to know'.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: In one direction, now. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go (on foot)', paired with 'пойти'.

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to
meanings.note: + dative (кому). Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.

+ accusative (что). Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.

meanings.en: to try hard, do one's best
meanings.note: Followed by infinitive. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'стараться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to try, make an effort', paired with 'стараться'.

meanings.en: to stop, put an end to
meanings.note: Прекрати! = Stop it!. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to stop, quit', paired with 'прекращать'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'давец'). Common masculine noun meaning 'shop assistant, seller' in everyday Russian.
